title: Eliphaz Speaks: Seek God

questions.question: What kills the fool?
questions.explanation: Job 5:2 (ESV): "Surely vexation kills the fool, and jealousy slays the simple."

questions.question: Man is born to trouble as what?
questions.explanation: Job 5:7 (ESV): "but man is born to trouble as the sparks fly upward."

questions.question: What would Eliphaz do if he were Job?
questions.explanation: Job 5:8 (ESV): "As for me, I would seek God, and to God would I commit my cause,"

questions.question: How does Eliphaz describe God's discipline?
options: Blessed is the one whom God reproves
questions.correctAnswer: Blessed is the one whom God reproves
questions.explanation: Job 5:17 (ESV): "Behold, blessed is the one whom God reproves; therefore despise not the discipline of the Almighty."

questions.question: From how many troubles will God deliver?
options: Six, and in seven no evil shall touch you
questions.correctAnswer: Six, and in seven no evil shall touch you
questions.explanation: Job 5:19 (ESV): "He will deliver you from six troubles; in seven no evil shall touch you."

questions.question: What does God do to the crafty?
options: He catches the wise in their own craftiness
questions.correctAnswer: He catches the wise in their own craftiness
questions.explanation: Job 5:13 (ESV): "He catches the wise in their own craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are brought to a quick end."

questions.question: What happens to the poor according to Eliphaz?
options: He saves the needy from the sword of their mouth
questions.correctAnswer: He saves the needy from the sword of their mouth
questions.explanation: Job 5:15 (ESV): "But he saves the needy from the sword of their mouth and from the hand of the mighty."

questions.question: What does God do with rain?
options: He gives rain on the earth and sends waters on the fields
questions.correctAnswer: He gives rain on the earth and sends waters on the fields
questions.explanation: Job 5:10 (ESV): "he gives rain on the earth and sends waters on the fields;"

questions.question: How will you approach your grave in old age?
options: Like a sheaf of corn gathered in due season
questions.correctAnswer: Like a sheaf of corn gathered in due season
questions.explanation: Job 5:26 (ESV): "You shall come to your grave in ripe old age, like a sheaf gathered up in its season."

questions.question: With what will you be in league?
questions.explanation: Job 5:23 (ESV): "For you shall be in league with the stones of the field, and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you."

questions.question: What will happen to your offspring?
questions.explanation: Job 5:25 (ESV): "You shall know also that your offspring shall be many, and your descendants as the grass of the earth."

questions.question: God wounds, but what else does He do?
questions.explanation: Job 5:18 (ESV): "For he wounds, but he binds up; he shatters, but his hands heal."

questions.question: What will you not fear according to Eliphaz?
questions.explanation: Job 5:22 (ESV): "At destruction and famine you shall laugh, and shall not fear the beasts of the earth."

questions.question: What did Eliphaz say about the fool's habitation?
questions.explanation: Job 5:3 (ESV): "I have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly I cursed his dwelling."

questions.question: What conclusion does Eliphaz reach?
options: Hear it and know it for your good
questions.correctAnswer: Hear it and know it for your good
questions.explanation: Job 5:27 (ESV): "Behold, this we have searched out; it is true. Hear it, and know it for your good."

key_verse_text: Behold, blessed is the one whom God reproves; therefore despise not the discipline of the Almighty.
